method: GEOS polygon intersects on antimeridian-normalized Natural Earth 1:50m country polygons and latitude-clipped spherical Voronoi TAC polygons; includes boundary-touching cells, with no count cap.

grid.cellGeometry: Full TAC cells are rendered; country intersection only determines which ids are included.
grid.boundaryPrecision: Float32 input coordinates; great-circle edges densified at 0.05 degree maximum step before GEOS predicates.
